newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends firmer on commercial buying.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends firmer on commercial buying.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures ended firmer, and commercial-related buying helped widen the intermarket spread with CBOT March wheat, traders said.
Traders said spring wheat also drew light support from ideas that it closed lower and out of line Monday relative to CBOT and KCBT wheat.

The MGE's weekly deliverable spring wheat stocks report underscored the tightness in wheat supplies in the Minneapolis area. The report said 891,000 bushels of spring wheat were in deliverable positions in Minneapolis, compared with 788,000 last week and 4.1 million last year.

MGE spring wheat settled two to four cents per bushel higher. March settled up two cents at $3.78-1/2 a bushel -- its first higher close since last Tuesday. May gained four cents to close at $3.62-1/2.
Traders said May was boosted late as Atwood-Peavey bought on the close.
MGE barley futures settled unchanged to five cents per cwt higher, with March unchanged at $6.55.
